lines.text: Dinner time at Leo's house! Steaming bowls of delicious vegetable soup on the table!
SLUUURP! Leo dipped his spoon and slurped so loudly, the walls shook!
Soup splashed on his shirt, and breadcrumbs tumbled onto the floor like confetti!
Dad smiled gently and said, Welcome to the Royal Knight Banquet, Sir Leo!
Royal knights place their soft linen napkin across their lap like a secret banner!
They blow softly on each spoonful, chew with quiet closed lips, and say please!
Leo tried the Royal Knight style—suddenly eating soup felt like an elegant adventure!
Kind table manners show love to the chef and keep dinner peaceful for everyone!
